task_summary: The agent was asked to modify a spreadsheet so that rows in column B are ordered by helper-column J into the output range F2:H20, preserving the specified grouping and duplicate rules. The final file had to be written to /app/output/1_22-47_output.xlsx.

explicit: Read /app/spreadsheets/1_22-47_input.xlsx and write the modified workbook to /app/output/1_22-47_output.xlsx.
Populate F2:H20 so rows are ordered by helper column J, keep in-group source order, skip empty cells/headers/duplicate (B,C) pairs, and fall back to A-Z only if J is empty.
implicit: Inspect the workbook before editing it so the correct sheet and source rows are used.
Preserve all cells outside the verified range F2:H20 and keep the other sheets intact.
Check the helper list in column J and apply the duplicate rule on matching B/C pairs.

closeness_to_success.explanation: The trial never reached spreadsheet manipulation. Step 1 is only the prompt, and step 2 is a provider-side validation error, so there was no opportunity to read the workbook or create the output file (`trajectory.json:18-32`).

root_cause.summary: The Claude Code wrapper sent a malformed API request and the run exited on a 400 validation error before any spreadsheet work began. The failure text names the invalid field `messages[1].***.list[ChatMessageContent][2].cache_control`, which is a request-construction problem rather than a task-solving problem.

failing_test_evidence.what_verifier_checks: The verifier sets `proc_path = /app/output/{task_id}_output.xlsx` and returns `False, "Output file not found"` when that file is absent (`tests/evaluate.py:174-176`, `tests/evaluate.py:203-206`). If the file exists, it compares only the first sheet's `F2:H20` range (`tests/evaluate.py:183-186`).
failing_test_evidence.what_agent_produced: No spreadsheet file was produced. The only agent-side output is the provider error in `trajectory.json:28-32`; there were no tool calls and no file-writing step.
